user.title: Select a Dimplex panel heater
user.description: Choose a nearby panel heater reachable through a passkey-enabled ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.

pair.title: Start panel heater pairing
pair.description: Start a pairing request to {name}, then watch the panel heater for its PIN. Home Assistant will not start pairing automatically while a repair is waiting, so one panel heater cannot block other proxies.

passkey.title: Pair Dimplex panel heater
passkey.description: Enter the six-digit PIN shown on {name}. The panel heater's PIN request expires about 30 seconds after it appears. Home Assistant automatically tries a limited number of requests while this setup stays open. The PIN is sent through the selected ESPHome proxy and is not saved.

reauth_confirm.title: Repair Dimplex panel heater authentication
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the six-digit PIN shown on {name} to restore the Bluetooth bond.

reconfigure.title: Repair Dimplex panel heater authentication
reconfigure.description: Enter the six-digit PIN shown on {name} to restore the Bluetooth bond.

abort.already_configured: This panel heater is already configured.
abort.no_heaters_found: No Dimplex panel heaters were found. Enable Bluetooth on the panel heater and try again.
abort.not_dimplex: The advertisement does not identify a Dimplex panel heater.
abort.proxy_passkey_support_missing: This panel heater is visible, but no nearby ESPHome Bluetooth proxy has an encrypted API and the required passkey relay.
abort.proxy_unavailable: The selected Bluetooth proxy is unavailable.

error.device_not_found: That panel heater is no longer in the discovered-device list.
error.proxy_passkey_support_missing: The selected proxy cannot accept a Bluetooth PIN.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed or timed out. The panel heater's PIN request expires after about 30 seconds. Home Assistant automatically retries a limited number of times; submit the PIN again to start another bounded attempt. Check the panel heater display before entering a PIN.
error.pairing_in_progress: This ESPHome proxy is pairing with another panel heater. Finish or cancel that setup, then try again.
error.invalid_hvac_mode: That HVAC mode is not supported by this panel heater.
error.temperature_not_allowed_in_auto: The panel heater follows its timer in Auto mode; set the temperature in a non-scheduled mode.

state.preheats_room_to_target_before_timer_per: Pre-heats the room so the target temperature is reached by the start of a timer period.

state.models_room_heating_characteristics_and_: Models the room's heating characteristics and starting temperature.

state.continuously_learning_two_hour_limit_all: Learns continuously, enforces a two-hour calculation limit, and should be enabled on all panel heaters in the same room.

state.switches_heater_to_heating_off_when_open: Switches the panel heater to Heating Off when an open window is detected.

state.detects_sudden_decrease_in_room_temperat: Looks for a sudden decrease in room temperature.

state.may_trigger_in_drafty_poorly_insulated_o: May trigger incorrectly in drafty or poorly insulated rooms, or when the panel heater is undersized.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the panel heater over Home Assistant Bluetooth. Check that a connectable Bluetooth adapter can reach it and that pairing is already established.

authentication_failed.message: The panel heater's Bluetooth authentication has expired or was lost. Re-enter the PIN to repair the connection.

characteristic_unavailable.message: The requested GATT characteristic is missing or does not support that operation.

protected_characteristic.message: This characteristic is blocked because reading or writing it is unsafe or exposes device credentials.

invalid_gatt_request.message: The GATT group, characteristic, or hexadecimal payload is invalid.

invalid_experimental_payload.message: Enter hexadecimal bytes for this experimental field.

invalid_experimental_payload_length.message: Enter exactly the required number of hexadecimal bytes for this experimental field.

invalid_setpoint.message: The requested target must be a whole-degree Celsius value within the panel heater-reported range.

invalid_preset.message: The requested preset is not supported by this panel heater.

setpoint_unavailable.message: The panel heater has not reported a usable setpoint range yet.
